summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 results. The press release details financial performance: revenue up 5.8%, beer volume growth of 1.2%, and underlying EPS increasing 20.8% to $0.97. The filing is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, with no mention of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or other special situations. It provides operational highlights but does not trigger any special-situations category. This is a standard periodic report, not a special event.
